dedupe_keys.name: bluefield research data navigator water market project m a and forecast data subscription

description: Bluefield Research, a water market research firm, offers its corporate subscription clients a Data Navigator platform with direct access to water market data: projects, mergers and acquisitions, and forecasts, shown in customisable dashboards that filter by region, segment, geography and company type. Coverage: the navigator page lists forecast data on biosolids, capital expenditure on pipes and treatment, data centres, digital water, industrial water, metering, PFAS, stormwater, trenchless rehabilitation, water for hydraulic fracturing and water reuse, and company data on corporate sustainability, desalination ownership, digital water deals, vendors and venture capital; the dashboards page lists coverage of Asia Pacific, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa, and the US and Canada, with market drivers such as the cost of water, infrastructure investment, policy, quality and risk. Other listed products include a Europe data centre water demand forecast and US industrial water facilities data. Format and access: web platform for subscribers; each corporate subscription includes one seat, and demos are booked through the site. Cost: paid; prices were not read. Licence: proprietary; terms were not read. Caveats: the pages describe the platform but not field lists, update frequency or export options, and whether project records carry locations or asset detail was not checked. Simulation uses: capital expenditure forecasts and project pipelines for water and wastewater infrastructure, as context for investment and capacity planning scenarios. Related records: the EPA Safe Drinking Water Information System (data-epa-sdwis-federal-drinking-water-systems) is an open list of US public water systems.
